name: Adventure Pack
description: 23 guns for minigames: assault, automatic, burst and service rifles, a submachine gun and machine pistol, five pistols, six shotguns, field and lever rifles, three sniper weapons and a taser, with ammo boxes to pick up. Turn on Adventure Pack Rules for magazines, reloads and headshots. Our own remake of Bushido's Adventure Pack: new models and sounds, Bushido's line-up and design.
authors: Design: Bushido's Adventure Pack (Bushido, re-released by Conan)
